subject: Repro playbook + MAP milestones: performance convergence & close timeline
messages:

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimblecloud.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@beaconhealth.ai>
Subject: MAP draft + initial benchmark ask

Priya —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Anna and I pulled together a rough Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a couple of questions about benchmarking methodology before we lock the timelines. High level asks from BeaconHealth:

- We need documented TTFT (time-to-first-token) and sustained throughput numbers at 8k context for p95 and p99 under 50 and 150 concurrent sessions.
- Repro steps so our infra team can validate numbers on their pre-prod (GCP us-central1) using the Redwood runtime or an equivalent harness.
- Clarify any differences we should expect if we use our own load generator (k6 + custom prompt sampler) vs Redwood's test harness.

Can you confirm whether the MAP can include a 2-week trial for Dedicated capacity and a decision deadline of 2026-07-30? We'd like a single-page runbook that our SREs can follow.

Cheers,
Raj
Senior SRE, NimbleCloud (procurement for BeaconHealth)

Date: 2026-07-19T11:12:00-07:00
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimblecloud.com>
Cc: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@beaconhealth.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Re: MAP draft + initial benchmark ask

Raj — thanks for the clear asks and the draft MAP. Quick confirmation on scope:

- We can produce TTFT (p50/p95/p99), sustained throughput, and token/sec curves at 8k context. We'll also run a concurrency sweep at 50/150/300 sessions to show degradation curves.
- We'll provide a reproducibility playbook (md) and a Redwood harness artifact. If Beacon wants to run on their GCP pre-prod, we'll include k6 config and sample prompt CSV.
- Differences: our harness uses continuous-batching and prefix-KV caching by default; we will provide a config set that disables caching to match a plain k6 run if desired.

I copied Karthik (benchmarking lead) to scope the runs and Neha (solutions) to coordinate the MAP timelines. We're fine with the 2-week trial; proposed decision milestone 2026-07-30 is feasible if we start runs this week.

Action: Karthik to share repro playbook + timeline by EOD 7/20.

—Priya
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-07-19T13:02:00-07:00
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Re: MAP draft + initial benchmark ask

Raj / team —

Drafting the repro playbook now. Key points I'll include:

1) Test matrix: model variant (gptx-8k-int8 / gptx-8k-fp16), sequence lengths (512, 2048, 8192), concurrency (50, 150, 300), load pattern (steady vs burst), and prompt diversity sampled from your corpus.
2) Harness discrepancies: Redwood harness simulates live inference (streaming + KV caching). k6 baseline will be request-per-call. We'll publish config to toggle caching/batching.
3) Measurement definitions: TTFT (time from request to first token byte emitted), server-side queuing time, and token generation rate. We'll capture CPU/GPU utilization and kernel stall metrics.
4) Repro steps: k6 script + sample prompt CSV, env vars for model checkpoint and quantization, and a small helper tool to replay response streaming for TTFT measurement.

I'll attach the markdown instructions (20260721-repro-instructions.md) and aim to run an initial Redwood-hosted run against a pinned model variant tomorrow (7/20) so we can share numbers to seed the MAP.

Karthik
Benchmarking Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: 20260721-repro-instructions.md
Date: 2026-07-20T09:18:00-07:00
From: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@beaconhealth.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimblecloud.com>, Procurement <procurement@beaconhealth.ai>
Subject: Re: MAP draft + initial benchmark ask

Thanks — couple of clarifying Qs before you run the Redwood-hosted baseline:

- For the k6 script, can you set up the csv sampler to reflect 40% short prompts (<128 tokens), 50% medium (128-1024), 10% long (1024-8192)? That's representative of our workload.
- We cannot enable caching in our pre-prod run; please include a no-cache configuration for your baseline so we compare apples-to-apples.
- TTFT measurement must be reproducible without streaming parsing (our SREs will look at the first non-empty chunk).

If you can deliver the baseline numbers (p50/p95/p99 TTFT and sustained token/sec) by EOD 7/20 we'll update the MAP and push procurement to include a short POC contract.

—Anna
Head of AI Ops, BeaconHealth AI
Date: 2026-07-20T18:00:00-07:00
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@beaconhealth.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimblecloud.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Re: MAP draft + initial benchmark ask — Redwood baseline results

Anna / team —

Attached are the Redwood-hosted baseline runs (CSV attached). Key findings summarized:

- Config: gptx-8k-int8, no prefix caching, batching disabled to mimic request-per-call. Prompt mix: 40/50/10 as requested.
- TTFT (ms): p50=75, p95=210, p99=380 at 50 concurrency; at 150 concurrency p50=95, p95=340, p99=740.
- Sustained token/sec: steady-state 8k context: 1,800 tokens/sec at 50 concurrency; 1,250 tokens/sec at 150 concurrency; 600 tokens/sec at 300 concurrency.
- Observations: p99 increased non-linearly after ~180 concurrent sessions due to queueing and kernel headroom limits on the instance type.

Repro notes: we disabled KV caching and continuous batching to mirror k6; attachments include k6 config and the exact env vars. Please try the GCP pre-prod run with the provided CSV and send logs if you see divergence.

Next: Neha will coordinate a joint reproduction test on Tues 7/21 where we will run Redwood-hosted and Beacon pre-prod back-to-back.

Karthik
Date: 2026-07-21T11:40:00-07:00
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@beaconhealth.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimblecloud.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Re: MAP repro test coordination

Team —

We kicked off the joint reproduction window this morning. Quick log from our side:

- Redwood-hosted run replicated prior numbers within 5% for p50/p95.
- Beacon pre-prod (GCP n1-standard + T4 equivalent) initially showed TTFT p95 ~2.5x our baseline and token/sec ~40% lower.

Triage so far points to two likely causes: 1) different GPU driver/kernel versions causing kernel selection fallback, and 2) their load generator was invoking a client-side retry middleware that inadvertently serialized requests (we've captured traces showing a 10–30ms client-side addition per call).

Immediate asks for Beacon SREs: send us GPU driver version, container runtime (runc vs gVisor), and the k6 script copy. We'll fast-follow a no-retry, plain TCP test to isolate client-side effects.

We'll capture a second run this afternoon after the SRE changes and share updated CSV.

—Neha
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP repro test coordination — final readout & next steps

Anna / Raj / Procurement —

Thanks for the rapid iteration this week. Summary and MAP updates:

- Root causes identified and mitigated: client-side retry middleware (fixed) and mismatched driver that forced a slower kernel path (Beacon updated to the recommended NVIDIA driver).
- Post-fix joint run (CSV attached: 20260722-map-benchmark-results.csv) shows convergence: p95 TTFT within 10% of Redwood baseline at 150 concurrency; sustained token/sec within 12% at 8k context.

Updated MAP milestones:
- 7/23: Finish POC contract (legal + procurement sign-off)
- 7/24–8/06: 2-week Dedicated trial (provisioned capacity, telemetry enabled)
- 8/07: Trial completion readout and pricing/commit decision window opens
- 8/14: Final contract signature target (if POC goes well)

Open items for procurement: draft SOW for Dedicated trial and proposed credit (we recommend a 10% trial credit). Raj / Procurement — can you confirm approval to route a POC SOW to legal by EOD 7/23?

If we get sign-off tomorrow we can keep the 7/30/2026 decision milestone in the original MAP as an internal checkpoint; public-facing decision will shift to the 8/07 readout.

Thanks everyone — attaching the runbook and final CSV for your records.

—Priya
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
